messages.subject: Struggles with dynamic input fields
parts:
Hi

slider which gives the range of years in which that pitcher played in the MLB. The user then selects
some year(s) within this which along with the playerid is used for further processing

The change in sliderInput range works fine visually but I am getting these errors

Warning in min(value) : no non-missing arguments to min; returning Inf
Error in if (min(value) < min) stop(paste("slider initial value", value,  : 
  argument is of length zero

and the Data reactive function does not appear to be actioned
